note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Windows Admin Center runs as a gateway on CON-SRV02; the browser is Microsoft Edge inside the CON-SRV02 VMConnect window. Mixed PowerShell + Edge screens are app screens with the typed commands listed in steps.
prepare: Invoke-Command -Session $s { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\lab | Out-Null; Remove-Item C:\lab\ep06 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
$pw = Read-Host -AsSecureString "Password for alex.demo (owner types, never shown)"

Invoke-Command -VMName CON-DC01 -Credential $cred -ArgumentList $pw { param($p) if (-not (Get-ADUser -Filter "SamAccountName -eq 'alex.demo'")) { New-ADUser -Name "Alex Demo" -SamAccountName alex.demo -UserPrincipalName alex.demo@lab.contoso.com -AccountPassword $p -Enabled $true } else { Set-ADAccountPassword -Identity alex.demo -Reset -NewPassword $p; Enable-ADAccount -Identity alex.demo } }

teardown: Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SRV01 -Credential $cred { Unregister-PSSessionConfiguration -Name Microsoft.Sme.PowerShell -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "Windows Admin Center Administrators", "Windows Admin Center Hyper-V Administrators", "Windows Admin Center Readers" | ForEach-Object { Remove-LocalGroup -Name $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Get-ChildItem "C:\Program Files\WindowsPowerShell\Modules" -Directory -Filter "Microsoft.Sme*" | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force }

Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SRV02 -Credential $cred { $u = (Get-ItemProperty "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*" | Where-Object DisplayName -eq "Windows Admin Center").PSChildName; if ($u) { Start-Process msiexec.exe "/x $u /quiet /norestart" -Wait }; Remove-Item C:\lab -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
